title: Stable domain-artifacts reason-code catalog — ADR-0128 §13/§21/§22, plan §28
note: Stable identifiers for every domain-artifacts resolver decision. Part of the public contract: consumers (lifecycle WF-0065, enforcement WF-0067, telemetry) may key on them. Codes are append-only; renaming/removing one is a material change requiring a Decision.

codes.ARTIFACT_SCHEMA_VALID: Artifact document satisfies its declared schema (all required fields present, correctly typed).
codes.ARTIFACT_SCHEMA_INVALID: Artifact document is missing a required field or has a wrongly-typed field.
codes.ARTIFACT_UNKNOWN_KIND: Requested artifact kind is not in the artifact-schemas table.
codes.ARTIFACT_REQUIRED_FOR_PROFILE: The resolved profile requires this artifact kind (requiredForProfiles).
codes.ARTIFACT_NEVER_FOR_PROFILE: Proportionality guard: the resolved profile must never generate this artifact kind (neverForProfiles).
codes.ARTIFACT_NOT_REQUIRED: The resolved profile neither requires nor forbids this artifact kind.
codes.PACKET_COMPILED: Implementation Packet compiled successfully from owner + classification + sources.
codes.PACKET_MISSING_SOURCE: Packet compilation refused: a declared source (business/operation/workflow/decision/use-case) is absent.
codes.RECEIPT_BUILT: Implementation Receipt built comparing the packet against the actual result.
codes.RECEIPT_DEVIATION_DETECTED: Receipt found at least one planned-vs-actual deviation (files, agents, or skills).
codes.RECEIPT_CONTRACT_CHANGED: Receipt detected a change to a contract the packet declared as contractsToPreserve.
codes.RECIPE_RESOLVED: Task Compiler recipe resolved deterministically for the given profile.
codes.RECIPE_UNKNOWN_PROFILE: Recipe lookup failed: the profile has no declared recipe; resolution degraded, never a false pass.
codes.SCAFFOLD_RELEASED: Scaffold released: its required contract artifact exists and validates.
codes.SCAFFOLD_REFUSED_NO_CONTRACT: Scaffold refused: the required contract artifact is absent (constitution §8 default-to-refuse).
codes.SCAFFOLD_REFUSED_INVALID_CONTRACT: Scaffold refused: the required contract artifact exists but fails its own schema validation.
codes.SCAFFOLD_UNKNOWN_KIND: Scaffold refused: the requested scaffold kind is not in the scaffold-contracts table.
codes.SCAFFOLD_PLACEHOLDER_EMITTED: Scaffold emitted a typed placeholder field — never an invented business rule.
codes.ARTIFACTS_POLICY_DEGRADED: A domain-artifacts policy table is absent/unparseable; resolver degraded with a receipt, never a false pass.
